title: onprem: airgap offline bundle vendoring + rke2/flatcar TUF rollback tooling
author: Leah Chen
description: Add TUF rollback tooling and improve vendoring for rke2/Flatcar/Ubuntu sets in the offline installer bundles to address customers hitting corrupt TUF metadata and missing kernel modules in air-gapped deployments. This PR introduces: 1) rollback helper script (tools/tuf-rollback.sh) that can revert TUF metadata and mirror state on an air-gapped mirror; 2) vendored rke2 and Flatcar artifacts moved into /vendored/<distro>/<arch> with updated checksums and signed metadata; 3) Helm chart tweaks to make node selector and kernel-module hooks optional for distros that disable module loading; 4) Terraform module small changes to allow specifying alternate mirror endpoints and to enable the rollback step as part of upgrade pipelines. Motivation: customers running private installer in restricted networks saw two incidents where TUF metadata rotation and a bad vendoring job caused large fleets to fail upgrades (linked Linear: ENG-8721). The rollback flow is documented and guarded by explicit confirmation flags; the vendoring step now includes an integrity-check stage and a retry loop to avoid partial uploads. Notes: kept changes minimal to make cherry-picks to release branches easier. Testing: local integration with a k3s/rke2 flatcar image, end-to-end airgap bundle generation, and CI acceptance (initial flaky test fixed by smaller timeout increase on mirror sync). More context in Linear ENG-8721 and SUP-1983.
